e80edc116551f80a234843d0bc28570ab8c6808d: Between 10:02 and 10:40 IST, 14 accounts published 24 posts under #DevgarhJago following a four-phase narrative arc — CLAIM, AMPLIFICATION, INFLAMMATORY, MOBILIZATION — labelled as incitement. The campaign culminates in a mobilization call directing followers to gather at Purana Qila gate on Tuesday, 06 October at 10:00 IST.
6d222736bff3f0c42c32163c43737a35acc1e41c: Between 16:05 and 16:36 IST, 8 accounts published 12 posts under #DevgarhPaniAlert, falsely claiming that a water tank in Devgarh had been poisoned and that 20 people were hospitalised while authorities were concealing the incident. The campaign followed a CLAIM-to-AMPLIFICATION path and has been detected and labelled as misinformation, with no planned real-world event identified.
